question: Whose 'State of the Global Climate' report has revealed record sea level rise and exceptionally high land and ocean temperature over the past four years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**World Meteorological Organisation.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **World Meteorological Organization**

 
 
• The World Meteorological Congress is the supreme body of the WMO.
 
• It is headed by its **Secretary-General.​**
 
• It was established in **1950.**
 
• It is an intergovernmental organization that originated from the** International Meteorological Organisation (IMO).**
 
• WMO 'State of the Global Climate' report revealed record sea level rise and exceptionally high land and ocean temperature.
 
• The WMO State of the Global Climate in 2021 report confirmed that the **past seven years** have been the warmest seven years on record. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Intellectual Property Organization**

 
 
• The World Intellectual Property Organisation or **WIPO** is a **UN specialized agency.**
 
• It was created in **1967 **to promote intellectual property (IP) protection and encourage creative activity all over the world.
 
• WIPO is basically a global forum for IP policy, services, information and cooperation. 
 
• WIPO is a** self-funded agency** of the United Nations.
 
 
 
• **United Environment Programme**
 
 
• **​**The UNEP is responsible for coordinating responses to environmental issues.
 
• It was established by Maurice Strong in **June 1972.**
 
• Its mandate is to provide leadership, deliver science and develop solutions on a wide range of issues.
 
• The organization also develops international environmental agreements; publishes and promotes environmental science.
 
 
 
• **Food and Agriculture Organization**
 
 
• ​The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations is a specialized agency of the United Nations.
 
• It leads international efforts to **defeat hunger** and improve nutrition and food security.
 
• Its Latin motto, fiat panis, translates to "let there be bread".
 
• It was founded on **16 October 1945.**
